question: How does a sprint time measured to the thousandth of a second become the hundredths in the record book?
answer: Always upwards. Under World Athletics rules, a fully automatic time not ending in zero goes to the next longer hundredth: 10.041 becomes 10.05, while 10.040 stays 10.04. No runner is credited with time they did not run, and places come from the photo, so two runners can share a time yet not a place.
